per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains the extraction layer; the prior material_extracted_with_gaps label is nonblocking because the only blocker was analysis parsing of Table 2, and no supplementary assets exist locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Validator/structural contract is separate from publication grade; final acceptance follows source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair and strict gate reruns.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: primary source supports Tat/variant HIV-1 EC50 values and DRAMP/DBAASP variant rows where identity is staged; CAMP/dbAMP antibacterial spillover and incomplete identity rows remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted: Table 2 and Results/Figure 3 prose were manually parsed into source-located EC50 rows with endpoint, value, unit, target, MOI/assay context, and locators; qualitative MTT viability context is retained without fabricated numeric chart values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: the paper supports antiviral phenotype and charge-potency association, but no direct peptide-CXCR4 binding or molecular entry assay is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions because all blocking worker-2/4/6 issues were repaired or preserved as nonblocking source_conflict cautions, and no open rework targets remain.

caution_findings.note: CAMP/dbAMP rows include bacterial activity annotations for R-10 not supported by this primary paper; these remain source_conflict/database spillover cautions.
The paper does not directly assay peptide-CXCR4 binding, membrane translocation mechanism, or entry step; mechanism ontology is limited to phenotype and charge association.
The handoff request referenced supplementary/Table 3 checks, but packet inventory, OA tar members, and extraction reports show no supplementary asset and only two primary XML tables.
